items.title: Nvidia considers $10B investment in potential record Anthropic IPO: Reuters
items.summary: Anthropic is said to be seeking to raise as much as $100 billion in the offering, which could value the AI company at about $2 trillion.

items.title: GTA Mod Adds Flock Cameras—And Lets Players Destroy Them
items.summary: The surveillance mod on GTA V brings the privacy fight to Los Santos, where players can demolish the cameras tracking them.

items.title: Staked ether should be seen as the benchmark of the decentralized economy
items.summary: The yield-generating asset has a special place in the digital asset investor’s portfolio, argues GlobalStake’s Ryan Haczynski.

items.title: Former Alameda CEO Caroline Ellison joins nonprofit charity Manifund
items.summary: Former Alameda Research CEO Caroline Ellison has a new gig at the charity Manifund, its cofounder Austin Chen said Friday.
